register.name: OKIR / OKIRkapu
register.operator: National environmental registry (reports feed the MOHU concession)
register.notes: OKIRkapu portal fetched live 2026-08-16 ('OKIRKAPU – út az OKIR felé'). Dual registration in practice: OKIR/OKIRkapu (quarterly EPR filings) + MOHU service contract (producer ID, invoicing). Note (MOHU FAQ): foreign-made packaging finally separated from its product counts as own-use of packaging (EPR reg. §17) — so registration, reporting and fee liability arise.

pro.membershipRequired: state-concession — MOHU is the single concession holder, service contract mandatory
pro.ecoModulation: EPR fees set per material-flow (anyagáram) by government decree; unchanged for 2026 from the 01.10.2025 levels. Advertising paper (R01) 94 Ft/kg; textile packaging 148 Ft/kg.

extraTaxes.name: Környezetvédelmi termékdíj
extraTaxes.summary: Green product fee on defined product groups incl. packaging materials — separate from and partially offset against EPR fees.

notes: verified:false: OKIRkapu register was fetched and the MOHU FAQ (official) confirms the system, but the 2026 fee TABLE itself is set by a government decree (Magyar Közlöny) that could not be fetched from an official primary this session (NAK notice returned HTTP 503; MOHU pages carry no inline table). Rates shown are the widely-corroborated 2026 EPR díjtételek (Ft/kg, unchanged from 01.10.2025), converted at 362.95 HUF/EUR (2026-08-16): plastic 219 → 0.603, paper 173 → 0.477, glass 107 → 0.295, metal 186 → 0.512, wood 22 → 0.061, composite 191 → 0.526. Flip to verified:true once the decree/MOHU official rate table is fetched. EPR fees invoiced quarterly by MOHU based on OKIR filings; one-off enrolment fee for the MOHU producer ID.
